summary: Verified BUG 1 (legacy Finance route retirement) and BUG 2 (Division supervising District-hosted tournaments) fixes. Backend 7/7 pytest green on parent-Division scope guard. Frontend: legacy redirect worked for MPCA + DIV-IND personas, no legacy TournamentFinanceDetail content renders, fc-legacy-link removed, TournamentBudgetsPanel & TournamentInvoicesPanel links point to /finance (not /finance/legacy). DIV-IND correctly acts as organiser on a DIST-ALIR-IND–hosted tournament (Prepare panel, 'DIV-IND (organiser)' chip); DIV-BPL correctly denied on same tournament. NOTE: had to patch the redirect route itself — main-agent's `<Navigate to='../finance' replace />` resolved to `/finance` (nonexistent) because the route is flat under root, sending users to `/` via wildcard. Replaced with a small LegacyFinanceRedirect component using `useParams` to produce an absolute path.
action_items: None blocking. The redirect fix I applied is minimal (~4 lines in App.js) — main agent should code-review the LegacyFinanceRedirect component and useParams import addition.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js L196 (main-agent's original fix): `<Navigate to='../finance' replace />` at a top-level route is a footgun in React Router v6 — the `..` is resolved relative to the matched route which is flat under `/`, so it navigates to `/finance` (nonexistent) instead of `/tournaments/{id}/finance`. Fixed by extracting a `LegacyFinanceRedirect` component that reads `useParams()` and returns an absolute `<Navigate to={`/tournaments/${id}/finance`} replace />`.

finance_console.py L557-561: `is_parent_div_of_host_dist` doesn't verify body_code has len>=7 (needs at least `DIV-XXX`). If someone passes X-Body-Code='DIV-' the slice(-3) becomes 'IV-' → matches DIST-*-IV- if any exist. Low risk in practice.

The convention `myBody.slice(-3)` for Division suffix is duplicated in 4 places (TournamentDetail, TournamentFinanceConsole, TournamentFinanceCard, finance_console.py). Consider extracting a shared helper `isParentDivisionOfDistrict(divCode, districtCode)` in `/app/frontend/src/lib/tournamentAccess.js` (or bodies helper) and one Python helper — reduces drift risk.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 main-agent fix: `<Navigate to='../finance' replace />` — React Router v6 resolves `..` relative to the ROUTE, not the URL. Since this route is defined at the top level (no nested parent), `..` collapses to `/`, giving `/finance` which is unmatched → wildcard route sends to `/` (Landing). Fixed by introducing a `LegacyFinanceRedirect` React component that reads `useParams()` and issues an absolute `<Navigate to={`/tournaments/${id}/finance`} replace />`. Reproduction: visit `/tournaments/<any-id>/finance/legacy` when logged in as MPCA → lands at `/` (Landing page). After fix: lands at `/tournaments/<id>/finance` (Finance Console).
